items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: we used to run them everywhere we'd catch them... That was E. Vans band... we knew when we'd meet them out there out there will Buck

ctx.x: Did you ever know Bunk Johnson?

Sure, I used to play with Bunk Oh, yeah When Bunk first come here to leave here that last time, he come here to get me Oh, yeah But I was busy working, that's why he did to take Jim Crow And then Jim Crow and Howard and them, they was working together all the time So he couldn't get me the first week he was here, so that's why I just let him went on with him But Bunk come right there to get me Yeah, Bunk was playing with the Black Devil up in Tippeto up there I was playing with Punch, you ask Punch about it, we…
Buck like I don't know what. Punch was playing with us then.
